videourl.settings.askOnFailure.label: Ask when a video fails to play
videourl.settings.askOnFailure.descripti: When a playback failure is detected, asks whether to resolve the URL and copy it. Failures stay in the list even when this is off.
videourl.settings.server.label: Resolve on an external server
videourl.settings.server.description: Use this to avoid keeping yt-dlp and deno on this PC. When on, every resolve is sent to the external server.
videourl.settings.server.enabled.label: Use an external server
videourl.settings.server.enabled.descrip: When on, yt-dlp on this PC is not used, and the video URL is sent to the external server.
videourl.settings.server.url.label: Server URL
videourl.settings.server.url.description: The URL of an endpoint that returns yt-dlp's own output. The request is posted to exactly this URL (e.g. https://example.com/resolve).
videourl.settings.server.token.label: Server token
videourl.settings.server.token.descripti: Fill this in only when the server asks for a token. Left empty, the request is sent without one. It is masked on screen, but stored as-is in the settings file.
videourl.settings.server.timeout.label: Seconds to wait for a response
videourl.settings.server.timeout.descrip: An external server can take longer than resolving on this PC. Long videos take a while the first time.
videourl.settings.clients.label: Player clients
videourl.settings.clients.description: The clients yt-dlp presents itself as when it asks for a video. The defaults were chosen by measurement; there is usually no need to change them.
videourl.settings.clients.hls.label: Client for HLS
videourl.settings.clients.hls.descriptio: Only this client returns the high quality HLS streams (up to 1080p). Leave it empty to skip that request.
videourl.settings.clients.progressive.de: For the 360p mp4 that plays in any player. Changing it can make the URL you get fail with 403 at playback.
videourl.settings.clients.audio.label: Client for audio only
videourl.settings.clients.audio.descript: Fetches URLs that carry only audio, with no video. default is yt-dlp's default set of clients. Leave it empty to skip that request.
videourl.panel.failures.title: Playback failures
videourl.panel.failures.empty: No failed videos yet. They show up here when playback fails.
videourl.panel.running: Running yt-dlp (the first run also downloads yt-dlp and deno, so it takes a moment)…
videourl.notify.failed.title: A video failed to play
videourl.stream.hls.label: {0} video+audio (HLS)
videourl.stream.hls.note: For AVPro. Unity Video Player cannot play HLS
videourl.stream.muxed.label: {0} video+audio ({1})
videourl.stream.audio.label: {0} audio only ({1})
videourl.stream.audio.note: No video is shown. Some players may not play it
videourl.note.noHls: This video has no HLS stream with audio, so 360p mp4 is the ceiling

videourl.error.noInfo: Failed to get the video information (it may be private, age-restricted, or deleted)
